journey.name: Search - Second Pane (Explore and Summary)
journey.description:
Requires a wide window: a foldable unfolded, or a tablet. Start with the device unfolded and the app on the Home tab.
Verifies the Search tab's list-detail layout: the landing shows Trending in the list pane and Explore in the right pane, a submitted search shows a Summary in the right pane, and the Summary keeps its place across opening an item, folding and switching tabs. Uses the offline bench build, where the fake search returns the same posts for any query.

actions.action: Tap the Search tab on the main navigation rail
Verify that the list pane shows the Trending list and that the right pane shows Explore with Suggested feeds, People to follow and Starter packs
Scroll the right pane down slowly until the Starter packs section is visible
Verify that the Trending list in the left pane is unchanged
Tap the search bar in the list pane
Type a search query into the search field
Submit the search
Verify that the list pane shows the Posts, People, Feeds and Packs tabs
Verify that the right pane shows a Summary headed "Results for" followed by the query that was searched
Verify that the Summary shows the "Results for" header with the query and the top post
Scroll the Summary down slowly until the People, Feeds and Starter packs sections are visible
Verify that the People, Feeds and Starter packs sections are shown, each with "See all"
Tap "See all" under People in the Summary
Verify that the list pane shows the People tab selected
Tap the Posts tab in the list pane
Scroll the Summary back up to the top post
Tap the top post in the Summary to open it
Verify that the post detail is shown in the right pane next to the results
Press the system back button
Verify that the right pane shows the Summary again
Scroll the Summary down slowly until the header is off screen, and record the text of its topmost fully visible item
Tap a person in the Summary to open their profile
Verify that the profile is shown in the right pane
Press the system back button
Verify that the Summary is shown and that its topmost fully visible item is the recorded one
Fold the device
Verify that the app shows the search results list in a single pane
Unfold the device
Verify that the search results are shown in the list pane and the Summary in the right pane, and that the keyboard is not shown
Tap the Home tab on the main navigation rail
Verify that the Home feed is shown and that the right pane does not show any Search content
Tap the Search tab on the main navigation rail
Verify that the search results are shown in the list pane and the Summary in the right pane
Press the system back button
Verify that the Search landing is shown with the Trending list in the list pane and Explore in the right pane, and that the search field is empty
